title: Sundry payables & contract redline scratchpad
content:
Morning scratchpad — quick running log for invoicing and contract redlines. Not polished, just a capture so I don't miss anything before EOD.

Today objectives:
- triage outstanding vendor invoices (priority: AWS infra credits / marketplace fees)
- finish redline pass on Partner MSA (sheeted exceptions + indemnity language)
- flag upcoming renewals for Legal review (end of Q2)

Inbox triage (first pass):
- Invoice: VEND-3321 (DataPipe) — $12,480 — due 2026-03-17. Attachment missing P.O. email. Action: ping ops for PO number + hold payment until PO arrives. Slack to @Sophie (ops) "can you confirm PO for VEND-3321?" (Draft below).
- Invoice: CLOUD-2209 (edge provider) — $3,200 — seems duplicate of CLOUD-2091? mark "possible duplicate". Action: compare line items, escalate to procurement.
- Expense reimbursement: Rowan — hotel SFO conf (receipt partial). Quick reply: ask for folio + card last4.

Contract redline notes — Partner MSA (v2):
- Section 6.2 (IP carveouts): vendor proposed to keep all deliverables. Need to push back — propose "Deliverables created specifically for Redwood Inference during the term shall be assigned to Redwood; vendor retains background IP."
- Indemnity (sec 9): vendor wants reciprocal with caps tied to fees. Suggest add an exception for privacy/data breach and keep unlimited for gross negligence. Mark: TODO add cite to precedent (see LEG-879).
- Data handling / subprocessor list: request up-to-date subprocessor list + SOC2 report; set 7 business day SLA for updates.
- Term/renewal: auto-renew clause with 60-day opt-out. Recommend change to 30-day for smaller contracts, 90-day for enterprise? Note: check with product on go-to-market impact.

Draft email snippets (for quick copy/paste):
- To Sophie (PO ask):
  Hi Sophie — quick one: Vendor DataPipe (VEND-3321) submitted invoice but PO not attached. Can you confirm whether a PO exists for this invoice and share the number? If not, can procurement approve retrospective PO for accounting? Thanks —Jason

- To Partner legal contact (redlines summary):
  Hi Maya — attached is a tracked redline for the MSA. High-level: clarified ownership for deliverables, tightened data breach carveouts, and requested subprocessor list + SOC2. Can we aim for a short sync Thursday to resolve outstanding indemnity language?

Renewals & calendar flags:
- Zendesk integration (contract ends 2026-06-30) — notify CS + procurement by 2026-05-01 for pricing review.
- Analytics license (Mixlytics) auto-renews 2026-04-15 — current spend: $6.2k/mo — recommended: request discount or quarterly invoice instead of monthly.

Quick numbers (mental math):
- Outstanding vendor invoices this week: ~10 totaling ~$38k (incl. DataPipe). Cash runway impact minimal but need to avoid late fees.
- If we push Mixlytics to annual, ~8% saving (negotiate).

Follow-ups (short list):
- [ ] Confirm PO for VEND-3321 — Sophie (due 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Compare CLOUD-2209 vs CLOUD-2091 duplicate (due 2026-03-13)
- [ ] Complete redline pass MSA + save tracked copy to LEG-879 (due 2026-03-14)
- [ ] Add renewal reminders to ical for Zendesk + Mixlytics (due 2026-03-15)
- [ ] Upload vendor SOC2 docs to shared drive after receipt

Notes to self / heuristics:
- When vendor asks for "assignment" of IP, always add "created specifically for Redwood Inference" language. Avoid blanket assignments for vendor-created background tech.
- If indemnity cap requested, map cap to 12 months of fees unless data breach; add carveout for liability from gross negligence.
- Keep renewal opt-out windows consistent in procurement playbook — recommend 60-day default for third-party SaaS above $5k/mo.

Random scratch items (brain dump):
- Follow up with finance on last month's accrual mismatch (sheet show $4.2k variance). See Confluence note FIN-ops-payables > March reconciliation.
- Remember to add a short note in LEG-879 about escrow requirement for strategic partners.
- Check with Product about whether new Zendesk plan includes dedicated IP address (affects security).

Meeting prep — 2026-03-14 vendor call (DataPipe):
- Goal: get PO or payment plan; confirm delivery dates; ask about volume discounts.
- Questions: any open dependences? who is CSM? want contact info.

End-of-day quick log (fill in):
- 09:15 AM — triage inbox, flagged 3 invoices, pinged Sophie.
- 11:00 AM — first redline pass on MSA, added comments on IP + indemnity.
- 01:30 PM — lunch, quick Slack follow-ups.
- 03:45 PM — compared CLOUD invoices (likely duplicate).
- 04:50 PM — updated this scratchpad, queued redline to LEG-879 for review.

If I don't finish today: prioritize redlines and the PO confirmation. Lower priority: renewal calendar adjustments.

---
Local draft filenames: MSA_partner_v2_redline_JH_20260311.docx (save to /users/jason-hart/drafts), invoice-evidence-CLOUD-2209.pdf

End.
